subject.name: Sheet Metal Workers
subject.summary: Sheet metal workers fabricate, assemble, install, and repair thin metal products to drawings and dimensions, including ducts, drainpipes, cladding, and equipment housings. They check materials and dimensions, cut and bend, join seams, and inspect assembly quality; on-site work must follow equipment and work-at-height safety requirements.
